    PROCESS

    How We Work

    From first contact to delivery, every step is clear.

    1. 01

      Discovery

      Email us or fill in the form with your goals, scope, timeline and budget. We'll reply by email and go through the details with you.

    2. 02

      Proposal & Quote

      We propose a direction, schedule and itemized quote. Work starts once both sides sign.

    3. 03

      Pre-production

      Concepts, storyboards or prototypes to lock the direction before full production.

    4. 04

      Production

      Milestone-based delivery with reviews and revisions at every stage.

    5. 05

      Delivery & Support

      We hand over the final work and agreed source files, with support after delivery.

    ABOUT

    About the Studio

    DeepEcho is an independent game and digital content studio from Taiwan, crafting immersive, atmospheric interactive experiences with Unreal Engine 5. Alongside our original games, we take on commissions in game development, UE5 projects, 3D animation and media production.

    FAQ

    FAQ

    Didn't find your answer? Just email us.

    How do you price projects?

    Based on scope, quality bar and timeline. Send us your brief and we'll reply with an itemized quote.

    How long does it take?

    It depends on scale. Short animations or assets usually take weeks; games and interactive projects usually take months. Every proposal includes a schedule.

    How does payment work?

    Usually in installments, such as a deposit on signing, milestone payments and a final payment on acceptance. Ratios depend on the project.

    Who owns the rights?

    As agreed in the contract. Typically, once paid in full, rights to the final work are transferred or licensed to the client. Unless confidential, we keep the right to show it in our portfolio.

    Can you sign an NDA?

    Yes, we can sign one before discussing details.

    How many revisions are included?

    The number per stage is set in the contract; changes beyond that are quoted separately.

    Can we hire you for just part of a project?

    Yes, for example only 3D models, animation or UE5 technical support.

    Do you work remotely or with overseas clients?

    Yes. We work mainly by email, in Chinese or English, so every request and decision is kept in writing.
